# A short walk

The morning was quiet, and the *river* moved slowly under the bridge. She carried a **small notebook** and a pencil, because some thoughts only survive when written down.

Near the market she stopped to read a sign. The [town archive](https://example.org/archive) kept every record of the harbour, from the first ledger to the last. Visit <https://example.org/harbour> for the full index.
